newsitem.title: USA: Planet Hollywood plans Chicago mall site.
newsitem.headline: Planet Hollywood plans Chicago mall site.

text.p: Gurnee Mills Mall said Planet Hollywood would open its second Chicago-area location in August, with construction slated to begin April 1 on a 13,000 square foot site at the suburban shopping complex.
It said the Planet Hollywood restaurant would occupy renovated space currently leased by the Bugle Boy Outlet.
The decor will include movie memorabilia from films starring its celebrity owners, including Bruce Willis, Demi Moore, Arnold Schwarzenegger and Sylvester Stallone.
